numeric_policy: Decimal 40 significant digits; ROUND_HALF_UP final components and totals to 0.01; aggregation uses unrounded components; no float money
sector_aggregation: equal_weight_nine_arithmetic_mean; candidate choice, not Owner-approved sector weights

demand_growth_bps.label: 需求
demand_growth_bps.definition: 同口径行业实际销量/消费量同比增长 × 10000；前期量必须>0
demand_growth_bps.evidence_source: 官方行业统计原表，记录口径和修订
demand_growth_bps.window: 最新可见完整季度 vs 上年同期

demand_capacity_gap_bps.label: 供给
demand_capacity_gap_bps.definition: 行业需求同比增长bps − 可比有效产能同比增长bps；正值表示供给约束
demand_capacity_gap_bps.evidence_source: 官方需求与产能两张可比原表

price_orders_growth_bps.label: 价格及订单
price_orders_growth_bps.definition: (行业成交价格同比bps + 已确认新订单同比bps)/2；两者缺一即缺失
price_orders_growth_bps.evidence_source: 官方价格指数及有金额/量的订单披露；标题不足
price_orders_growth_bps.window: 最新完整季度 vs 上年同期

policy_balance.label: 政策
policy_balance.definition: 固定90日内独立且仍有效政策，支持条款计+1、限制条款计−1；同一政策去重；双人证据编码；冲突未知阻断
policy_balance.evidence_source: 生效政策原文+条款定位+两名编码人记录
policy_balance.window: cutoff前90个自然日；有效期覆盖cutoff

global_demand_bps.label: 全球趋势
global_demand_bps.definition: 同范围全球行业实际需求同比bps；不得用今日预测代历史实际
global_demand_bps.evidence_source: 可核验国际行业统计原表
global_demand_bps.window: 最新完整季度 vs 上年同期

margin_change_bps.label: 竞争格局
margin_change_bps.definition: 当时行业成员按收入加权毛利率同比变化bps；亏损成员保留，缺失成员不得静默移除
margin_change_bps.evidence_source: PIT行业成员+成员财报修订链
margin_change_bps.window: 最新四季度 vs 前四季度

sector_valuation_percentile.label: 估值
sector_valuation_percentile.definition: 正行业估值倍数在过去1260完整交易日弱排名 count(x<=current)/1260；方法/成员冻结
sector_valuation_percentile.evidence_source: 历史可见行业成员、财报与总市值，估值方法版本

sector_rs20_bps.label: 相对强弱
sector_rs20_bps.definition: 行业20交易日总回报 − 同期冻结基准总回报，×10000
sector_rs20_bps.evidence_source: 同币种总回报序列+公司行动+基准身份

sector_adverse_share.label: 风险
sector_adverse_share.definition: 行业成员中经核验有效重大不利事件公司的收入权重占比；明确全体覆盖才能填0
sector_adverse_share.evidence_source: PIT成员收入权重+重大事件逐项核对

revenue_growth_bps.label: 收入增长
revenue_growth_bps.definition: 最新可见TTM收入/前TTM收入−1 ×10000；前收入>0
revenue_growth_bps.evidence_source: 发行人修订版财报与累计转单季桥

cash_conversion.label: 现金含量
cash_conversion.definition: TTM经营现金流/TTM净利润；净利润<=0记缺失
cash_conversion.evidence_source: 发行人现金流、利润表版本

roic_spread_bps.label: 资本回报差
roic_spread_bps.definition: (ROIC−资本成本)×10000；需独立冻结资本成本方法，M01未批准不自动采用
roic_spread_bps.evidence_source: 财报+明确版本的资本成本估计

sector_revenue_share.label: 板块收入暴露
sector_revenue_share.definition: 公司归属该板块业务收入/总收入；必须绑定下方sector结果同一板块身份
sector_revenue_share.evidence_source: 分部收入披露与行业映射

catalyst_balance.label: 催化剂
catalyst_balance.definition: 固定60交易日内仍有效已核实订单/投产/业绩指引事件：正向+1、撤销/负向−1；去重、正文定位、双人编码
catalyst_balance.evidence_source: 交易所/发行人原文及编码记录
catalyst_balance.window: 60实际交易日；不得只根据标题

stock_rs20_bps.label: 趋势
stock_rs20_bps.definition: 个股20交易日总回报 − 对应行业总回报，×10000
stock_rs20_bps.evidence_source: 个股与行业总回报及公司行动

stock_valuation_percentile.label: 个股估值
stock_valuation_percentile.definition: 正选定倍数过去1260交易日弱排名；负盈利不可映射成低估值
stock_valuation_percentile.evidence_source: PIT财报、价格及版本化估值方法

median_turnover_cny.label: 流动性
median_turnover_cny.definition: 最近20实际交易日成交金额中位数（偶数取中间两项平均）；不是账户可成交容量
median_turnover_cny.evidence_source: 交易所日成交金额及单位桥

verified_fact_share.label: 证据质量
verified_fact_share.definition: 预先登记的必需事实中经原文、单位、修订和时钟核对的比例；分母不许删掉缺失事实
verified_fact_share.evidence_source: 固定事实清单+审核记录；不能单凭声明PIT通过
verified_fact_share.window: 该次研究固定事实清单

risk_rule: hard gates require PASS, any FAIL or UNKNOWN blocks both raw/final aggregates; all penalty flags require PRESENT or ABSENT, UNKNOWN blocks; each PRESENT charged once; final=max(0,raw-sum(penalties))
native_reuse: Hash-bound references to existing ResearchCard/BrainPacket 1.0.0 only; no native object emitted or altered

risk_definitions.concentration: Largest disclosed customer share of comparable latest fiscal-year revenue >0.50: PRESENT; <=0.50: ABSENT; incomplete/anonymous-range-straddling evidence: UNKNOWN.
risk_definitions.high_leverage: Latest comparable TTM net debt / EBITDA >3: PRESENT; <=3 with positive EBITDA and complete bridge: ABSENT; EBITDA<=0 or missing bridge: UNKNOWN (not zero).
risk_definitions.material_uncertainty: Two independently named coders record at least one unresolved noncritical adverse scenario with exact issuer/exchange source locator: PRESENT; signed complete review with none: ABSENT; no complete review: UNKNOWN. Critical thesis invalidation belongs to hard gate and cannot be softened.

hard_gate_definitions.source_integrity: All required original hashes/revisions/units/time sources checked by admitted input adapter; conflicting originals FAIL; absent checks UNKNOWN. Pure evaluator checks metadata binding only, cannot certify source honesty.
hard_gate_definitions.critical_evidence_complete: Every registered mandatory feature and window available, reconciled, source-scope allowed and exact source clocks supplied; critical missing UNKNOWN; known contradiction FAIL.
hard_gate_definitions.status_verified: Subject identity/current sector membership and security status known at cutoff; delisted/ST/suspended subject FAIL for this screening experiment; missing historical issuer/status facts UNKNOWN. Sector uses dated membership universe and coverage audit. This is not execution tradability approval.
hard_gate_definitions.thesis_intact: No verified thesis-killing event or unresolved hard negative after two-coder review; such event FAIL; incomplete review UNKNOWN.
